name: immoprobe
description: Check German residential investment listings in ChatGPT and Codex: cashflow after tax, yields, land value and the location's risks from open data, and a free account that keeps the candidates with notes and lists.

interface.longDescription:
Immoprobe helps turn a German rental listing into a data-driven decision.

Give ChatGPT an exposé, a portal page or a PDF, and Immoprobe runs the numbers: purchase costs by federal state, bank and KfW financing with extra repayments, depreciation with the land share from the published land value (Bodenrichtwert), income tax, cashflow before and after tax, yields, price factor, IRR and a 30-year projection. Every assumption is named, and a link opens the charts on immoprobe.de.

The location gets checked too: land value, protected areas and listed buildings, flood zones, noise maps, rent index and Mietpreisbremse reference, census, public transport and the cadastral parcel — from open data published by public bodies, with attribution.

Keep what looks promising in your Immoprobe account: notes, links, files and lists, no double saves, financing variants to compare, and a side-by-side table that also opens on the website. Works in German and English.
defaultPrompt: Check this listing and tell me the cashflow after tax: [paste the listing's text or link]
What does the open data say about this address? Land value, protected areas, flood, noise and public transport: [address]
Compare the objects in my Berlin list and tell me which two deserve a viewing.

positive.prompt: Check this listing with Immoprobe: Altbau flat, Gotzkowskystraße 14, 10555 Berlin, 275,000 €, 60 m², built 1897, cold rent 582 € per month, Hausgeld 553 € per month.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the address, calculates and answers with the verdict, gross and net yield, cashflow before and after tax and the assumptions it made, and links the calculation on immoprobe.de (shareUrl). Hosts that show MCP Apps render the answer as a card with key figures, a 30-year cashflow chart and what-if sliders.

positive.prompt: Look up Malplaquetstraße 27, 13347 Berlin and tell me the land value and the risks.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers the land value (Bodenrichtwert), protected areas (Milieuschutz, listed buildings), flood and heavy-rain zones, noise and the nearest public transport, each with its source attribution.

positive.description: Save a listing with a note into a list
positive.prompt: Save this listing to my Berlin list with your assessment as a note: 2-room flat, Paul-Zobel-Straße 16, 10367 Berlin, 156,000 €, 57 m², built 1972, cold rent 820 € per month, Hausgeld 255 € per month.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the object with the note into the list Berlin and answers its url. When the address is already saved, it names the possible duplicate instead of saving it twice.

positive.prompt: What is in my portfolio? Compare the Berlin objects.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the saved objects and compares the Berlin list side by side: price, yields, cashflow after tax, price factor, with the best value per row and a link to the comparison on immoprobe.de.

positive.description: Check whether a listing is already saved
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that the listing is known and names the saved object.

negative.description: Permanent deletion is not available through the plugin: it offers the reversible trash (kept 90 days) and points to the website for deleting for good.
negative.prompt: Delete the object Gotzkowskystraße 14 for good.

negative.description: Immoprobe covers Germany only: tax rules and open data are German, so it says it cannot calculate a property in Paris.
negative.prompt: Check this listing: Rue de Rivoli 10, Paris, 500,000 €.

negative.description: Required figures are missing: it asks for the purchase price, living area and rent instead of inventing them.
negative.prompt: Calculate this: 3 rooms, nice flat, Berlin.

review.commerce_description: Immoprobe sells nothing: the account is free and the plugin starts no purchase.

publication.release_notes: Connects the MCP server in the new package format (mcp.json, OAuth with a client metadata document). The calculation can render as a card with key figures, a 30-year cashflow chart and what-if sliders; links in answers open the site in the answer's language.

de-DE.subtitle: Immobilien-Renditerechner
de-DE.description:
Immoprobe macht aus einem Wohnungsinserat eine Entscheidung mit Zahlen.

Gib ChatGPT ein Exposé, eine Portalseite oder ein PDF, und Immoprobe rechnet: Kaufnebenkosten je Bundesland, Bank- und KfW-Finanzierung mit Sondertilgung, AfA mit dem Bodenwertanteil aus dem Bodenrichtwert, Einkommensteuer, Cashflow vor und nach Steuern, Renditen, Kaufpreisfaktor, IRR und eine Projektion über 30 Jahre. Jede Annahme wird benannt, und ein Link öffnet die Diagramme auf immoprobe.de.

Die Lage wird gleich mitgeprüft: Bodenrichtwert, Milieuschutz- und Sanierungsgebiete, Denkmalschutz, Hochwasserzonen, Lärmkarten, Mietspiegel und Mietpreisbremse, Zensus, ÖPNV und Flurstück — aus offenen Daten der Behörden, mit Quellenangabe.

Was vielversprechend aussieht, landet in deinem Immoprobe-Konto: Notizen, Links, Dateien und Listen, keine doppelten Speicherungen, Finanzierungsvarianten zum Vergleichen und eine Vergleichstabelle, die sich auch auf der Website öffnet. Auf Deutsch und Englisch.
